articles.title: Should You Buy BorgWarner Stock Because Its Share Count Keeps Shrinking?
articles.summary: BorgWarner (BWA) stock is up 55.9% over the trailing twelve months, and the business under it has been quiet. Sales grew 2.2% over the same twelve months, and profits have barely moved for three years. Shareholders have been paid anyway, because the company keeps buying back its own stock. Whether the cash keeps covering that buyback is the question.
